_readme: The engine now AUTO-BOOTSTRAPS the founding owner on first login:
sign in with an email listed in FOUNDING_OWNER_EMAILS
(js/firestore-data.js) and the users document is created
for you, keyed by your Firebase Auth UID.
Manual seeding still works if you prefer: create collection
'users' with the DOCUMENT ID below (it must equal the Firebase
Auth UID so the security rules can resolve the caller profile).
